notes.title: V1.01 Update - More for you!
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Hope you're all enjoying the conga action! There's been a small update to the game today, so please refresh your local content to get hold of it. The update contains the following improvements:

• Revised Japanese font - we decided the one used originally wasn't very readable, so we've upgraded to a much better one. Now all our Japanese friends can enjoy the game without having to work out what things say!

• More characters and levels from the start - We acted on feedback from people who wanted to dive straight into the multiplayer and thought that only four characters and one level to choose from was a bit stingy. Now, you can choose from eight characters and three levels straight away, so there's more choice for your multiplayer congas! 

(Please note: the remaining characters and levels still have to be unlocked in Story Mode as before. Also, the four characters now unlocked by default have had their unlocking achievements removed to compensate.)

• Bug fixes - a couple of rogue bugs have been cleaned up, because you can't conga responsibly when there are bugs about!

That's it... have fun, everyone!

The RSG Team
